verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms explicitly covers all three parts of the story. It onboards and verifies sellers, service providers, or contractors and reports the verification results. It processes payments on behalf of users, splits them between one or more users, deducts costs, and holds funds until payout, so users can sign up, sell, and receive payments within one solution. Missing for 10: API-level detail on seller onboarding, split, and payout mechanics; documentation of per-seller payout scheduling or methods; independent or hands-on corroboration of a marketplace build.
